title: group related labels fields
rule: Visually group related labels and fields; put each label close to its field (not equidistant from several).
pass_when: Related fields share a visual group; each label is closer to its own field than to neighbors.
fail_when: Related fields are ungrouped, or a label sits equally between two controls.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
